newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to target 102.40 if 102.60 breaks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to target 102.40 if 102.60 breaks.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will head for channel support around 102.40 on Monday if nearby support at 102.60 gives way, technical analysts said.

"It was an interesting week for Bunds last week," Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said. "We had pretty much an outside week and an inside day on Friday. That says the market is pretty volatile."
Bunds were quoted at 102.66 at 0733 GMT, down 13 basis points from Friday.
"If we get down through 102.60 then it will target 102.40, channel support," she said.
Support at 102.60, comes from the low on Thursday, Miller said.
She said if 102.40 also disappeared, the market would head for the 102.20 area, creating a rough double bottom in conjunction with the 102.17 low on July 15.

Earlier the German Bundesbank repored June M3 grew at an annualised rate of 6.4 percent on the fourth quarter of last year, down from 7.0 percent in May. Markets are also eagerly awaiting the results of the French audit.
Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here noted a band of congestion support at 102.50 to 102.60.
If that were knocked out, support would then come in at 102.33, the July 16 low, he said.
Miller said the outlook for the contract would not be too negative as long as it remained above 102.20.
"As long as 102.20 holds, there's still potential for it to break up to 103.15, the contract high," she said.

December Euromarks were quoted at 96.67, unchanged from Friday's settlement. Technical analysts at HSBC Futures in London said the recent rally may only be temporary with strong supply at 96.70 offering hefty resistance.
